page.label: Tuesday, September 22
page.text: Nothing is due. The story moves north to France: the Capetian kings and the Cathars. Keep the list you wrote in class on Monday, three things that made James I a great king. It comes back Friday with King St. Louis IX.

page.label: This week
page.text: Friday is King St. Louis IX. Keep The List on Spain in your notebook. It comes back too.

page.label: Build a Guild
page.text: Three guilds formed Thursday, September 10: fishmongers, blacksmiths, and bakers. Keep your charter answers from class. Each guild will write out a full charter in its best calligraphy and bring in a masterwork of its trade. The dates will be posted here and in Educate.

glance.text: nothing due; keep your James I list for Friday.
charter and masterwork dates to come.

page.label: Due Tuesday, September 22
page.text: Read Matthew 19:1 to 20:34. Annotate 20:17 to 34. Bring the page you wrote on Matthew 18: what each saying means by the number key. We open class by sharing them.

page.label: Coming this week
page.text: Wednesday: Matthew 21:1 to 23:39. Friday: Matthew 24 to 28, the end of the Gospel.

glance.text: Matthew 19:1 to 20:34, read; 20:17 to 34 annotated; bring your Matthew 18 page.

page.label: Tuesday, September 22
page.text: Dante is Everywhere. This has changed: you do not need to bring a poem. You will each get a short poem in class, read it closely, and present it in about two minutes: what it says, one trope (a figure of speech, such as a simile or a metaphor), and the link to Dante. If you already found a poem of your own, bring it and you may use it. Then we start Canto XXI. Cantos XXI to XXIII are due Wednesday.

page.label: Thursday, September 24
page.text: Quiz 2 on Cantos XIV to XXIII. Short answers in complete sentences. Know each ring and ditch: the sin, the punishment and why it fits, and the people Dante meets there.

page.label: Super Simile
page.text: Paragraphs 1 and 2 (the Charon birds, the Harpies) are in your folder. The folder stays in the room.

glance.text: poems handed out in class; nothing to bring.
Cantos XXI to XXIII, read and annotated.
Rehearsals Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, last period; the Friday sing at 1:23. The first all-school Friday sing was September 11.
